dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

kpi_note.title: A new view of booking demand
kpi_note.text: Booking Opportunities Captured was introduced in the last week of July, so 160 is a partial-period baseline rather than a since-launch total. It counts calls where someone expressed an intent to book, play or reserve and SpeakSport took the correct next action—sending the booking link or transferring the caller to staff.

highlights.title: Dynamic-pricing booking demand became an immediate online path
highlights.summary: A tee-time caller received a clear explanation of the dynamic-pricing model, chose to receive the booking link and was directed to live Pines and Oaks availability and rates.
highlights.quote: “You can view all real-time rates and secure your tee time directly on our website or mobile app.” SpeakSport then confirmed: “I have sent that link directly to your phone.”

highlights.title: A caller who preferred staff support was handed off appropriately
highlights.summary: After hearing the online booking option, a tee-time caller asked to speak with the clubhouse instead. SpeakSport respected that preference and transferred the caller to the pro shop.
highlights.quote: “No. Could I have the clubhouse?” SpeakSport responded by transferring the caller to the pro shop.

highlights.title: Range information was delivered before a targeted transfer
highlights.summary: A caller asking about range reservations received the available Trackman range hours, payment guidance and bucket price, then chose a transfer for the one detail that required staff confirmation.
highlights.quote: “Our Trackman driving range is open Tuesday through Sunday from 6 AM to 10 PM … The ball machine is card only, and a large bucket is $15.”

features_intro: For Fort Walton Beach, we have focused recent improvements on capturing booking demand reliably, giving callers the right online path and making each hand-off easier to understand.

features.title: Booking-opportunity tracking
features.description: The new KPI makes previously invisible booking demand measurable, including both text-link delivery and appropriate transfers to staff.

features.title: Stronger booking-intent recognition
features.description: SpeakSport is better able to recognise when a caller wants to book, reserve or play—even when speech recognition turns “tee time” into something less obvious.

features.title: Clearer online-booking hand-off
features.description: Standard booking callers can receive the direct link by text, while exceptions and callers who need human help are routed to the golf shop.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports filtering calls by intent, category and outcome, making demand patterns and operational opportunities easier to find.

future_note: We will continue enriching SpeakSport with capabilities such as self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love Fort Walton Beach to remain part of that journey—please keep sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep answers, hours and operating information current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of booking demand, link delivery, hand-offs and caller outcomes.
